questions.question: When do output source cues improve semantic alignment and survive full-RLM use?
questions.motivation: Large source-ID component gains now replicate on bounded new records and released models.
questions.smallest_followup: Use already authorized fixed-root bridge policy panel without changing its inputs; if useful, prospectively test high-width exposure on new groups, retaining no-uptake primary.
questions.readiness: Policy-panel sources prepared outside this catalog; new-width study not prepared
questions.promotion_revision_retirement: Promote if gains reach whole-task outcomes across new context clusters; revise if small-batch/uptake bottleneck dominates; retire broad whole-RLM claim if adequate-exposure replications remain null.

questions.question: Which limited root-training gains survive new query compositions and faithful native accounting?
questions.motivation: SFT/RL help some length outcomes but first-action strategy targets do not transfer.
questions.smallest_followup: Use prospectively frozen new query groups for executed full-procedure demonstrations/readouts; compare fixed starts/finals and matched dose, not winning checkpoints.
questions.readiness: New-panel work independently prepared; this record grants no implementation
questions.promotion_revision_retirement: Promote only replicated context-level query gains without excluding failures; revise target scope if copy/terminal syntax dominates; stop extending the same first-action dose without transfer.

questions.question: Can explicit reduction of actual supplied maps improve end-to-end answers without gold or automatic submission?
questions.motivation: Native traces identify map accumulation/reduction mistakes, not correct-scalar copying failure.
questions.smallest_followup: Prioritize approved supplied-map versus pure reducer diagnostic on the leaf-owned new panel. Keep labels unchanged, strict final model-submitted, all planned tasks, actual scope/map/call costs.
questions.readiness: Panel available; exact consumer and acceptance remain separately owned
questions.promotion_revision_retirement: Promote if root executes/uses reducer and gains correct finals on new contexts; revise if label disagreement dominates; retire automatic-finalization diagnosis unless an actual correct-scalar/wrong-final case appears.

questions.question: Can learned report choice preserve enough information for correct cross-partition composition on held-out query/structure combinations?
questions.motivation: User ideas1+5, supported by idea3, target an information boundary beyond typed validity.
questions.smallest_followup: First one-level diagnostic:4worlds×2valid partitions×3chunks with full input visible to parent. Compare ordinary unconstrained child reports, a declared lossy local-winner negative control, and hand-designed incidence/evidence. Exact-program and compute-matched direct baselines. Then learned report/representation choice on held-out query×structure combinations; do not treat constructed contrast as discovery.
questions.readiness: Design refinement needed to add ordinary-report baseline and freeze generator/split; no pilot implementation authorized
questions.promotion_revision_retirement: Promote interface feasibility only if ordinary reports lose cross-boundary information and sufficient reports improve correctness at measured cost; promote LEARNED claim only after held-out learned choice. Revise if exact code or report length explains gain; retire recursion claim if nonrecursive baseline matches.

questions.question: Can a learned compact task-local state support reliable fresh-root continuation at lower total cost?
questions.motivation: User idea6 is separate from input decomposition.
alternatives: Trace access shifts rather than saves cost
Prior Chained RLM already covers mechanism
questions.smallest_followup: Interrupt/resume held-out trajectories at frozen checkpoints: full history vs learned state plus accessible trace; charge reconstruction/retrieval and preserve failures.
questions.readiness: Needs bounded state contract and native resumption proof
questions.promotion_revision_retirement: Promote if correct continuation is retained at lower total cost on new checkpoints; revise state content after training-only diagnosis; retire novelty based merely on restarting roots.

questions.question: Do resumable task-local child handles buy useful information more cheaply than a comprehensive first return?
questions.motivation: User idea2; postpone until one-shot report sufficiency is understood.
questions.smallest_followup: Small/comprehensive/small-plus-followups under one global budget; exact ownership and no cross-episode persistence.
questions.promotion_revision_retirement: Promote only accuracy/cost benefit after charging every continuation; retire if comprehensive one-shot dominates.

questions.question: Can decision-level counterfactuals improve training-data selection beyond ordinary success trajectories?
questions.motivation: User idea4; named OpenReview reference remains unverified.
alternatives: Replay of fixed program is not resampled policy
Extra training data rather than better credit
questions.smallest_followup: Begin with training-only fixed-state alternative continuations; separate deterministic program replay from free root resampling; budget counterfactual cost.
questions.promotion_revision_retirement: Promote only matched-budget held-out improvement; revise if effect is ordinary additional sampling; do not claim citation is nonexistent.

questions.question: When should a recurrent-depth backbone spend compute internally versus on external decomposition?
questions.motivation: User idea7 needs a backbone actually trained for recurrence.
questions.smallest_followup: Only after a pinned recurrence-capable model exists: equal-compute internal/external/mixed policy comparison.
questions.readiness: No qualified backbone; no experiment ready
questions.promotion_revision_retirement: Promote only matched architecture/training-budget evidence; retire any proposal based on looping arbitrary vanilla layers.
